name: Glimmer Frog
blurb: Glows a little when it rains and croaks a tune about llamas.

name: Parrot Pennant
blurb: Repeats everything the rain says, then shouts it louder.

name: Keel Drift
blurb: Glides past the reef with a slow wink and a very old shell.

name: Last Forge Flame
blurb: The wyrm’s last little flame from the forge, curled up and dreaming of dragons.

name: Little Box Queen
blurb: A box jelly as square as a cube who insists she is the queen.

name: Big Grin Anaconda
blurb: A huge anaconda coiled in the hollows creek, grinning from ear to ear, who only ever wants a hug.

name: Mazeroot Mangrove
blurb: A little mangrove that grew its roots into a maze over the dark water and forgot the way out.

name: Fluffytail Snow Leopard
blurb: A fluffy snow leopard curled up in its own long tail on the ledge, purring like a little avalanche.

name: Baobab Innkeeper
blurb: A baobab-shaped innkeeper with a glowing door, who welcomes every traveller with a friendly rustle.

name: Noodle Skipper
blurb: A gnome in a pointed straw hat who sells noodles from a little boat and always has one more bowl.

name: Towel Bear
blurb: A sleepy bear wrapped in a warm towel, who steams happily outside the sauna and waves at the aurora.

name: Maple Mayor
blurb: A jolly maple-leaf mayor who taps every tree in town and hands out syrup at the door.

name: Dancing Pinkcap
blurb: A plump pink mushroom who twirls at the head of the ring and hands round small gifts.

name: Candle Boat Pilot
blurb: A small floating lantern that steers itself along the river, carrying one wish.

name: Nudging Boto
blurb: A chubby pink river dolphin who nudges you toward the next hidden seed.

name: Rooftop Courier
blurb: A chibi white stork on a rooftop perch, parcel ready, waiting for the evening delivery round.

name: Swallow Swoop
blurb: A chibi swallow swooping round the ruin, wings tucked and tail flicked, delivering seeds to the terraces.

name: Hollowhome Bluebird
blurb: A chibi bluebird peeking from a round hollow in the green cliff, singing along to the fall.

name: Tuftear Chipmunk
blurb: A chibi chipmunk with big tufty ears and purple socks, holding a little white orb on top of the stump.
